name: Loving Your Children
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as His reward, calling for loving care and disciplined guidance. Loving children involves both tender provision and firm correction, as shown by the necessity of training and chastening to lead them in the right path and impart wisdom. Even when earthly parents may fail, the Lord faithfully gathers and sustains His children, underscoring the divine responsibility and privilege in nurturing them. This love is grounded in God’s providence, reminding parents not to be anxious but to trust Him in caring for their family’s needs.
